affordances: You are escorting one sealed cargo unit.
It is important, guarded, and not supposed to be opened without permission.
It is going to Hush, a village in the Goldspire Territories.
The route crosses Sablewood Logistics Preserve: a vast fantasy forest, called Old Sable by some locals.
